products.title: Foundations of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu by Bernardo Faria
products.body:
Bernardo Faria is a 5x Black Belt World Champion 

  • Bernardo is considered by many the master of fundamentals
  • With this easy to learn system you will be able to develop a strong foundation
  • The fundamentals are the most important part of Jiu Jitsu, basics are what wins
  • Learn the same basics that led Bernardo to 5 World Championships
  • The perfect instructional set for anybody of any age, rank, athletic level, and fitness level.


Learn The Fundamentals & Concepts That Have Allowed Bernardo Faria To Become One Of The Greatest Champions Ever To Step On A Mat – While Having Less Athletic Ability Than Almost Any Elite Competitor He Faced

products.title: Fundamentals of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu Escapes Gi & No Gi by Lachlan Giles
products.body:
Learn how to escape from Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu’s worst positions with Lachlan Giles’s new 8-volume series on escaping

  • Watch Lachlan spar from bad positions with narration so you can see the techniques at work
  • This series covers both gi and no-gi solutions and concepts for getting out of mount, back, side control, and more
  • Understand each position’s threats, how to stay safe, and your path back to safety better than ever before.



Get Out Of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu’s Worst Positions, Gi Or No-Gi, With Lachlan Giles’s Insights Into Escaping

The 2019 ADCC Absolute Medalist Teaches How To Get Out Bad Grappling Positions With Narrated Live Rolling Of Him Performing The Techniques

What Will You Learn?

Learn how to escape from Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu’s worst positions and survive underneath with Lachlan Giles’s new 8-volume series on escaping gi or no-gi. Lachlan shows how he gets away from all major controls, including the mount, side control, the back, and more, both with and without a gi on. Watch as Lachlan breaks down every position to the major concepts, movements, escapes, and more, and tying his techniques together with narrated footage of him sparring from these same positions.

Lachlan Giles shows his full system for escaping trouble, so you can stay in the fight once your guard is passed and danger is near. With half in the gi, and half out, you can get reliable answers for both styles that can build off each other. In no time, you will be escaping fluidly from tight top control and submission threats with these pathways to freedom.

Understand the dangers and weaknesses of each of the major positions you’ll get stuck in, as Lachlan explains how to stay safe and work your way out with technique. Get out of tight side controls, mount, back control, front headlocks, and more as he takes each one and explores every detail you’ll need. In every position, Lachlan goes through all the variations as well, explaining how they’ll change your answers and how to stay cool under pressure so you can think easier.

Combine all of the most important fundamental movements of escaping together to create a potent escape style, with these helpful insights from ADCC Absolute medalist Lachlan Giles. Lachlan’s thorough and step-by-step instructions help students of any level understand and benefit from his knowledge, and with these details in your game you can stop fearing the guard pass so much and start attacking with style.

It’s inevitable that if you do Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, especially early on, you will get your guard passed a lot, and escaping from bad positions is one of the most important jobs of a BJJ student. Now, arm yourself with the knowledge you need to make these escapes like clockwork, with Lachlan’s 8-volume series. Learn the techniques, learn the system, then watch the system in action as he goes live from all the same positions to show his method at work.

products.title: Knee Lever John Wayne Sweep Engineering by Adam Wardzinski
products.body:
Unlock The Full Potential Of The Knee Lever With World Class Competitor Adam Wardzinski By Using His Hands-On Guide To Mastering This Powerful System!

  • Adam Wardzinski is a BJJ black belt, top-tier competitor, and known for having one of the most effective butterfly guards of ALL-TIME!
  • Explore how the knee lever provides powerful offensive options including off-balancing techniques, sweeps, and back takes, as well as a powerful tool to help you get unstuck from some of Jiu-Jitsu’s most difficult positions.
  • Upgrade your half guard game with an anthology of knee lever options from a wide range of half guard variations such as knee shield, lazy butterfly, half butterfly, and MORE!
  • Adam’s John Wayne sweep system also blends perfectly with other powerful half guard options like the Coyote half guard and underhook half guard.
  • Never get stuck flat on your back from half guard again with a systematic approach to using the knee level to open up even the tightest chest to chest top control!
  • Make opponents tap faster than ever with Adam’s tricky shotgun armbar setup that perfectly synergizes with the knee lever system!
  • Diversify your bottom half guard game with Adam Wardzinski’s COMPLETE 4-part knee lever masterclass!
